# Pull request

Thank you for the contribution. Please complete the checklist below before requesting review.

## Summary

What does this change do, and why?

## Linked issue

Closes #

(If there is no linked issue, please open one first — see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no user-visible change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, packaging, or CI

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`cargo test` once the daemon lands).
- [ ] New tests added or updated for the behavior changed.
- [ ] [`CHANGELOG.md`](../CHANGELOG.md) updated under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] Commit messages follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) convention.
- [ ] Documentation updated where user-visible behavior changed.
- [ ] I have read and agree to abide by the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Screenshots, logs, or sample output

Optional. Helpful for UI- or output-affecting changes.

## Additional notes

Anything reviewers should know — design tradeoffs, deferred follow-ups, areas where you would like specific feedback.
